agent.input: Draft and send email to vendor@yahoo.com with subject 'Purchase Order' and content regarding our equipment order with purchase_order.pdf attachment

arguments.subject: Purchase Order
arguments.body: Equipment Order Inquiry - Purchase Order Documentation
arguments.email_content:
Dear Vendor,

We are writing to you regarding our equipment order. Attached please find the purchase_order.pdf document which contains detailed information about our equipment requirements and specifications.

Please review the attached file for:
- Equipment details and quantities ordered
- Delivery schedule expectations  
- Technical specifications required
- Any additional documentation needed

Kindly confirm receipt of this email and let us know if you require any clarification regarding our purchase order requirements.

We appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,
HR Department
